Select the first 200 rows from the metabolism table. Join substrate compound_records via metabolism.substrate_record_id and join compound_structures on the substrate molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles and substrate_compound_key; this substrate-side structures join must be INNER so canonical_smiles is not null. Join metabolite compound_records via metabolism.metabolite_record_id to retrieve metabolite_compound_key; this metabolite-side join may be LEFT to allow missing metabolite records. Return exactly canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, and pathway_key. Do not add sorting; preserve source row order.
